conditions.displayName: /health failed twice in a row from at least two checker regions

documentation.content: The API's `/health` failed its last two checks (5 minutes apart) from at least two regions: phones can't generate. First run `deploy/cloudrun/smoke.sh --no-live`, which names the failing layer (domain mapping, revision, the server, the pages host). Then see docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts.
